notes: Implementation commit identifies the unchanged compiler and examples; the new benchmark harness is fingerprinted in report.json and retained in inputs.tar.gz.
samples.tar.gz retains all built artifacts, commands, stdout, stderr, driver statistics and engine timing files.
Tool fingerprints identify the named executables and Wasmtime library, not all compiler subprocesses or system libraries.
inputs.tar.gz retains benchmark, driver, runner, workload, golden and standard-library sources; tool binaries are identified by hashes and versions rather than archived.
